title: Principles of Economics Refresher
description: Interactive Econ 101/102 refresher: supply-demand sandbox with directional-change quiz, GDP accounting identity (C+I+G+NX) with component sliders, market structure comparison (perfect competition/monopolistic/oligopoly/monopoly), and 30-card key-terms flashcard deck.
data_vintage: Framework: Mankiw (2021), Principles of Economics 9th ed.; Samuelson & Nordhaus (2010)
